Compassionate Leadership Self-Assessment and 360 Evaluation

The Compassionate Leadership Self-Assessment and 360 Evaluation help you reflect on how closely your everyday behaviours align with the Compassionate Leadership Principles.

Whether you’re exploring your leadership style, preparing for a development programme, or responding to feedback, these tools offer a simple and meaningful way to understand where you are now - and where you can grow.

What the Tool Does

Both the self-assessment and 360 evaluation ask you to rate yourself against statements linked to the seven compassionate Leadership Principles . With the 360 evaluation, choose colleagues to provide anonymous feedback, giving you a rounded view of your strengths and development needs.

Once completed, you receive a clear visual report that shows how your behaviours align with each principle. You’ll also get a tailored set of resources based on your responses, helping you focus your development where it will have the greatest impact.

These tools help you:

  • Build self-awareness about how you lead
  • Understand how others experience your leadership
  • Identify strengths you can build on
  • Make the best use of your development time with targeted resources

When to Complete an Assessment

The self-assessment or 360 evaluation can be used at any point in your leadership journey.

You can use them because you:

  • Are starting a leadership or development programme
  • Have been asked to reflect on their leadership behaviours
  • Want structured feedback from colleagues
  • Are preparing for a new role or responsibility
  • Are preparing for an appraisal or revalidation
  • Are simply interested in understanding their impact
